SELECT 
    d.XCL_037 || ' ' || d.XCL_038 AS full_name,
    d.XCL_042 AS wikipedia_link
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    qualifying q ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
JOIN 
    races r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
JOIN 
    circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE 
    d.XCL_041 = 'Germany'
    AND d.XCL_040 > '1975-12-31'
    AND q.XCL_060 = 3
    AND c.XCL_003 = 'Spain'
    AND r.XCL_070 >= '2005-01-01'
ORDER BY 
    d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1
